versions.localizedDescription: Complete localization (219 keys, all cs+en), all hardcoded strings → keys, and a minimalist Settings redesign (Account 2 cards, .primary icons).
Version history in Settings, local new-email notifications (including background), and a pull-to-refresh fix that no longer snaps the inbox back to the old position.
